run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with a max arity argument to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros for a given max arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to a given arity
review_implementation_for_arity: review the ImplementationForArity function that generates C++ template code and macros for n-ary predicate assertions
review_tests_for_arity: review the TestsForArity function that generates 64 test combinations for n-ary predicate assertion macros
